# NJ Pro Tiling

> Professional wall & floor tiling services based in Melbourne, VIC, Australia. Licensed and fully insured. Specialising in bathrooms, kitchens, splashbacks, waterproofing (AS 3740), floor & wall tiling, outdoor/patio tiling, and tile repairs.

## Contact
- Phone: 0468 372 835
- Email: njpro.tiling@gmail.com
- Area served: Melbourne metropolitan area, VIC, Australia
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00am–5:30pm

## Services
- Bathroom tiling & renovations
- Floor tiling (porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, large-format, timber-look)
- Wall tiling & feature walls
- Kitchen splashbacks
- Outdoor & patio tiling
- Waterproofing (compliant with Australian Standard AS 3740)
- Tile repair & regrouting
